purpose: (Clinical Focus: This value set indentifies patients who have had a face-to-face interaction with a member of their medical care team.),(Data Element Scope: This value set was intended to map to the QDM data type of encounter.),(Inclusion Criteria: Includes both initial and follow up visits. Includes home visits, inpatient and outpatient visits, and nursing facility visits.),(Exclusion Criteria: Excludes visits that are not performed in-person, including telehealth services.)
